scenarios.name: your-permanents-untap-during-an-opponents-untap-step
scenarios.why: 'Untap all permanents you control during each other player's untap step': a creature of yours tapped by attacking stays tapped through your own turn end, then untaps in the opponent's untap step.

scenarios.name: without-the-muse-your-tapped-creature-stays-tapped-in-their-turn
scenarios.why: Control: with no Seedborn Muse on the battlefield the tapped attacker stays tapped during the opponent's upkeep (creatures only untap in their controller's untap step).
